name: Dexter Drake
title: The Magician
ability:
[fast] During your turn, discard an asset you control: Play an asset with a different title from your hand, reducing its cost by 1. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may return an asset from your play area to your hand. Then, draw 1 card.
ability_cn:
[free]在你的回合中，丢弃一张你控制的支援卡：从你手牌打出一张不同名称的支援卡，其费用减1(每轮限制一次)。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将你游戏区域的一张支援卡返回你的手牌。然后，抽取1张卡牌。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +2. You may return an asset from your play area to your hand. Then, draw 1 card.
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将你游戏区域的一张支援卡返回你的手牌。然后，抽取1张卡牌。
flavor_text: "Do you want to see true magic?"
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Showmanship, Occult Scraps, 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入牌组卡牌张数)：精湛手法、密教残页、1张随机基础弱点。
